summary: Sasol filed a routine Form 6-K (the foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) dated 30 September 2026, containing only a JPEG graphic page and no substantive textual disclosure. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock appear in the excerpt, so it cannot be mapped to any special-situation category. The filing is treated as an ordinary current report pending review of the underlying exhibit. What to watch: whether the attached graphic discloses any material corporate action.
